prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Recompose the supplied wide photographic black-obsidian asset into a NEW TALL PORTRAIT production plate, 853 x 1844 pixels, approximately 9:19.5 aspect ratio. Final canvas MUST be portrait. Do not rotate or simply crop the source. Preserve the source's true obsidian material, conchoidal curved fracture, mineral weight, black studio atmosphere and natural sculptural character.
Subject: one monumental dense black volcanic-glass sculpture, recognizably obsidian, with its large or almost complete outer contour visible. It has beautiful curved shell-like fracture planes and a few precise soft grey-white reflected bands on LOWER curves. It is not chrome, polished metal, plastic or a faceted gemstone. Absolutely no internal heat or warm light.
CRITICAL LAYOUT: the entire top 7 percent is pure black. The LEFT 85 percent from 18 to 43 percent of image height must be smooth near-pure-black NEGATIVE SPACE, entirely empty of object, grey reflections and texture. This area will later hold a two-line large headline and three lines of small copy; render no text. All upper background is deep black.
Place the main obsidian sculpture across the LOWER HALF, from approximately 51 to 93 percent of image height. Its high point can be just right of center at 51 percent height. Give it monumental scale: it occupies almost the full portrait width, with a wide heavy base around 92 percent height and one lower corner gently cropped at the right boundary. Most of the silhouette is visible against black; it must never look like a small e-commerce product isolated at the bottom. Its impressive curved black planes dominate the lower half. Make all pale reflections occur below 57 percent height, exactly along selected long conchoidal curves; leave the upper parts of the rock dark with only thin quiet edge light. A near-black stone floor below may carry the faintest reflection, no pedestal, no rectangle, no product card.
The visual thesis is dense black glass discovering reflected light. Natural black material, sharp broken edges, curved fracture, extremely fine geological detail, restrained controlled still-life lighting, warm-neutral black background with neutral white reflections. Create exquisite material photography, not CG metal.
No text, numbers, UI, buttons, lines, arrows, borders, watermark or other objects. No orange, red, fire, smoke, particles, blue neon, translucent colored glass or broad white-lit surface.
